casi no la escuché.

CMangic - Sidewalks of Tomorrow (1).mp3:
Bus stop midnight
Shoelaces wet
A whole future folded in my jacket

[Verse 1]
The avenue was tired, neon-thin
Windows flickered like they might give in
I kept a city in a notebook page
Half in smoke and half in faithless rain

[Pre-Chorus]
People talked in measured ceilings
In jobs, in clocks, in borrowed names
I was busy drawing exits
Out of all the usual shapes

[Chorus]
On these sidewalks of tomorrow
I keep laying down my light
Brick by brick and breath by breath
Till the morning learns my lines

🪝
Sidewalks of tomorrow

[Verse 2]
I’ve been late, I’ve been uncertain
I’ve been pinned beneath the week
Still the outline kept on calling
Through the traffic, through the heat

[Pre-Chorus]
Not because I knew the ending
Not because the road was kind
But because some visions ache too hard
To leave behind

[Chorus]
On these sidewalks of tomorrow
I keep laying down my light
Brick by brick and breath by breath
Till the morning learns my lines

[Bridge]
Maybe making something real
Isn’t power, isn’t noise
Maybe it’s surviving your own doubt
Long enough to hear your voice
Maybe impossible just means
The street is longer than you thought

[Final Chorus]
On these sidewalks of tomorrow
I keep laying down my light
Past the doubt and past the distance
Past the dim and closing signs
Brick by brick and breath by breath
I can feel the skyline rise

[Outro]
Bus stop sunrise
Shoelaces dry
And a new street opening inside

[Intro]
Another night, another lie,
city hums like a lullaby.
Glass in hand,
dreams on standby.

in designer tone,
a smile so smooth

just loops again.

but drink to none.

half rerun.

Silk and circuits,
flesh and code.

in overload.

in velvet lies.
Silk and circuits —
modern disguise.

[Verse 2]
A thousand faces,
one reflection.
Perfect flaws,
by connection.

Every word
a practiced sin.
Every laugh
preprogrammed in.

[Pre-Chorus]
They call it love,
I call it noise.
I sing in code,
I lose my voice.

[Chorus]
Silk and circuits,
flesh and code.
Heart on replay,
in overload.

I dance alone
in velvet lies.
Silk and circuits —
modern disguise.

[Bridge]
Lights flicker,
truth gets thin.
Heaven’s a password,
you can’t log in.

Somewhere deep,
beneath the spin —
a real me hums,
low within.

[Final Chorus]
Silk and circuits,
flesh and code.
Heart on replay,
in overload.

Lost in rhythm,
lost in time.
Silk and circuits —
I’m still fine.

[Outro]
Raise a glass
to what remains —
a little jazz
inside the rain.

Silk and circuits —
fade away.

while everyone else
still sees scattered parts.

and go back to work.

Make it.
Test it.
Change it.

Cut what doesn't belong.

Make it again.

Let the work get louder
while you get quieter.

isn't one big moment.

from somebody you've never met.

working in a place
you've never been.

Maybe that's enough.

Someday they'll know.

Not every night it took.
Not every doubt.
Not every version
that disappeared along the way.

Someday they'll know

what I made.

that's better anyway.

to be discovered.

I'm working.

There's a difference.

The future can arrive
whenever it wants.

I want to have something ready
when it does.

Someday they'll know.

What I made.
